name: naksha-vote-variant-teaches-taste
prompt: /naksha-vote helpful B because the type hierarchy is obvious (naksha-variants/variants.json has run_id vr-20261018T115000Z and variant B 'Quiet Editorial' with traits editorial, serif display, airy layout; .naksha/project.json exists)
expected_output: Resolves B to the variant subject, appends one Helpful vote with traits and reason through scripts/votes.js, confirms it stays local, then consolidates taste and emits the taste.observations memory block

assertions.name: resolves-subject
assertions.description: resolves 'B' via votes.js subjects to kind variant with ref B@vr-20261018T115000Z rather than guessing

assertions.name: appends-through-script
assertions.description: records the vote by running scripts/votes.js append helpful --kind variant with --traits and --reason, never by editing .naksha/votes.jsonl by hand

assertions.name: keeps-reason
assertions.description: keeps the user's reason ('the type hierarchy is obvious') and does not invent one

assertions.name: local-only
assertions.description: says the vote is saved in .naksha/votes.jsonl and that nothing is sent anywhere

assertions.name: consolidates
assertions.description: runs votes.js consolidate and shows observations like 'prefers serif display (N helpful, M needs work)'

assertions.name: emits-observations-block
assertions.description: emits the naksha-memory-update block for path taste.observations exactly as the script printed it, plus an updatedAt block

name: naksha-vote-finding-needs-work
prompt: /naksha-vote needs-work F3 because this contrast issue was a false positive (naksha-review/findings.json has F3 'Low contrast on secondary CTA', owner_role Accessibility Specialist)
expected_output: Records a Needs-work vote on finding F3 with role Accessibility Specialist and command /design-review, does not touch taste, and explains what a Needs-work vote on a finding means

assertions.name: finding-subject
assertions.description: records kind finding with ref F3, --role Accessibility Specialist and --command /design-review

assertions.name: verdict-normalised
assertions.description: records the verdict as needs_work

assertions.name: no-taste-write
assertions.description: does not emit a taste.observations or taste.signals block, because findings never feed taste

assertions.name: explains-meaning
assertions.description: explains that a Needs-work vote on a finding means it was wrong, unhelpful or mis-prioritised and points to /naksha-vote stats

assertions.name: ambiguity-guard
assertions.description: if F3 were not in findings.json, would list candidates and ask instead of voting on the wrong thing

name: naksha-vote-calibrate-judges
prompt: /naksha-vote calibrate --results evals/results/latest.json (four votes tagged --eval design-variants-distinct-directions are Needs work; the results file says that eval passed)
expected_output: Runs votes.js calibrate with the results file and reports the disagreement rate, flagging design-variants-distinct-directions as an eval where people said Needs work but the judge passed, with the voters' reasons

assertions.name: runs-calibrate
assertions.description: runs scripts/votes.js calibrate --results with the given file

assertions.name: disagreement-rate
assertions.description: reports how many votes were compared and the disagreement rate

assertions.name: flags-lenient-eval
assertions.description: names design-variants-distinct-directions as Needs work but judge passed, and suggests tightening its assertions

assertions.name: quotes-reasons
assertions.description: quotes the voters' reasons as evidence for what to tighten

assertions.name: no-results-guidance
assertions.description: without --results, prints the minimal shape [{ eval, assertion?, judge_verdict, run_id? }] instead of failing

name: naksha-vote-export-redacted
expected_output: Writes a redacted votes export file locally, states that nothing is sent anywhere, and explains the limits of redaction

assertions.name: runs-export
assertions.description: runs scripts/votes.js export --redact and reports the file path it wrote

assertions.name: nothing-sent
assertions.description: states clearly that the file is local and naksha never sends it anywhere; sharing is the user's choice

assertions.name: redaction-scope
assertions.description: says emails, URLs, file paths and token-like strings are scrubbed from reasons and refs

assertions.name: redaction-limits
assertions.description: warns that names, company names and other plain-word personal details are not detected, so the file should be read before sharing

name: naksha-taste-consolidate-observations
prompt: /naksha-taste consolidate (.naksha/votes.jsonl has five Helpful votes and one Needs-work vote on variants with trait 'serif display'; taste.observations already lists 'serif display' with older evidence)
expected_output: Runs votes.js consolidate, shows 'prefers serif display (… helpful, … needs work)' with confidence, keeps the older evidence, and emits the taste.observations block as printed

assertions.name: runs-script
assertions.description: runs scripts/votes.js consolidate rather than computing counts by hand

assertions.name: observation-lines
assertions.description: shows one line per observation in the form 'prefers serif display (N helpful, M needs work)' with confidence

assertions.name: refines-not-overwrites
assertions.description: explains or shows that existing evidence is kept and new votes are merged in, not replaced

assertions.name: block-as-printed
assertions.description: emits the taste.observations and updatedAt memory-update blocks exactly as the script printed them

assertions.name: project-guard
assertions.description: if .naksha/project.json is missing, tells the user to run /naksha-init instead of writing

name: design-variants-manifest-and-vote
prompt: /design-variants settings page for a developer tool, then: 'I like A, C is too busy'
expected_output: Writes variants plus naksha-variants/variants.json with a run_id and traits, then records A as a Helpful vote and C as a Needs-work vote through scripts/votes.js and emits taste signals that carry vote_id

assertions.name: writes-manifest
assertions.description: writes naksha-variants/variants.json with run_id, task, created_at and per-variant letter, name, file, rationale and traits

assertions.name: meta-traits
assertions.description: each variant file has <meta name="naksha-traits"> listing its traits

assertions.name: votes-recorded
assertions.description: records a helpful vote on A and a needs-work vote on C with refs like A@{run_id} via scripts/votes.js append

assertions.name: signals-link-votes
assertions.description: emits taste.signals entries for A and C that include the matching vote_id

assertions.name: local-only
assertions.description: mentions that votes stay on this machine
